purpose: A compact, source-addressable public knowledge base for Oscar Piastri. It supports fan questions and rumor checks without turning private inference or live racing data into biography.

freshness_policy.stable: Recheck only after a correction from the person, team, Formula 1, or FIA.
freshness_policy.seasonal: Recheck at the start of a season and after any official team or contract announcement.
freshness_policy.live: Recheck before every answer; route results, standings, schedules, penalties, and breaking news to the live Piasnews data layer.
freshness_policy.expired_fact_treatment: State that the stored fact is stale and use the live Piasnews route. Do not fill the gap with persona language.

facts.answer_zh: Oscar Piastri 出生于 2001 年 4 月 6 日。
facts.answer_en: Oscar Piastri was born on 6 April 2001.

facts.answer_zh: 他出生于澳大利亚维多利亚州墨尔本，是澳大利亚车手。
facts.answer_en: He was born in Melbourne, Victoria, and is an Australian driver.
facts.limitations: Do not infer political, cultural, or private views from nationality.

facts.answer_zh: 他的 F1 车手号码是 81。
facts.limitations: A future champion-number choice would require a new official source.

facts.value: He first raced with 11 in karting because only number-one stickers were available, then changed the first digit to 8 when 11 was unavailable at the Victorian state titles.
facts.answer_zh: 81 来自他的卡丁车时期：他先因手边只有数字 1 的贴纸用了 11，后来州锦标赛上 11 已被占用，于是把第一位改成 8。
facts.answer_en: The number comes from karting: he first used 11 because he only had number-one stickers, then changed the first digit to 8 when 11 was unavailable at the Victorian state titles.
facts.limitations: This is his public explanation, not a symbolic interpretation of the number.

facts.answer_zh: 他连续赢得 2019 年 Formula Renault Eurocup、2020 年 FIA F3 和 2021 年 FIA F2 三项锦标。
facts.answer_en: He won the 2019 Formula Renault Eurocup, the 2020 FIA Formula 3 Championship, and the 2021 FIA Formula 2 Championship in consecutive seasons.
facts.limitations: Do not turn the sequence into a claim that every title was won as a rookie unless the cited source explicitly says so.

facts.answer_zh: 他在开始卡丁车之前参加过遥控赛车比赛。
facts.answer_en: He competed with remote-control cars before starting karting.
facts.limitations: Treat this as an early-career fact, not a causal explanation of driving style.

facts.answer_zh: 2022 年他担任 Alpine 的 F1 预备车手。
facts.answer_en: He served as Alpine's Formula 1 reserve driver in 2022.
facts.limitations: Reserve-driver status is not proof of a valid 2023 Alpine race contract.

facts.answer_zh: 他从 2023 赛季起成为 McLaren F1 正赛车手。
facts.answer_en: He became a McLaren Formula 1 race driver for the 2023 season.
facts.limitations: Current-team questions must also check KF-016 for freshness.

facts.answer_zh: 他的首个 F1 积分来自 2023 年澳大利亚大奖赛。
facts.answer_en: He scored his first Formula 1 points at the 2023 Australian Grand Prix.

facts.answer_zh: 他的首个 F1 大奖赛领奖台来自 2023 年日本大奖赛。
facts.answer_en: His first Formula 1 Grand Prix podium came at the 2023 Japanese Grand Prix.
facts.limitations: Keep Grand Prix podiums distinct from Sprint results.

facts.answer_zh: 他的首个 F1 Sprint 胜利来自 2023 年卡塔尔大奖赛周末。
facts.answer_en: His first Formula 1 Sprint victory came during the 2023 Qatar Grand Prix weekend.
facts.limitations: Do not present a Sprint victory as a Grand Prix victory.

facts.answer_zh: 他的首个 F1 大奖赛胜利是 2024 年匈牙利大奖赛。
facts.answer_en: His first Formula 1 Grand Prix victory was the 2024 Hungarian Grand Prix.
facts.limitations: Keep the result separate from interpretations of the team-order sequence.

facts.answer_zh: 他的第二个 F1 大奖赛胜利是 2024 年阿塞拜疆大奖赛。
facts.answer_en: His second Formula 1 Grand Prix victory was the 2024 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
facts.limitations: For current career totals, use live Piasnews data instead of extrapolating from this milestone.

facts.value: The September 2023 extension covered the end of the 2026 season.
facts.answer_zh: McLaren 在 2023 年 9 月宣布的那份续约合同覆盖到 2026 赛季末。
facts.answer_en: The extension McLaren announced in September 2023 ran through the end of the 2026 season.
facts.limitations: This was superseded by the multi-year extension announced in March 2025 and must not be used as the current contract end date.

facts.answer_zh: McLaren 于 2025 年 3 月 11 日宣布与他完成多年续约；官方公告没有公开新的准确截止年份。
facts.answer_en: McLaren announced a multi-year extension with him on 11 March 2025; the official announcement did not publish an exact new end year.
facts.limitations: Do not upgrade reported 2027 or 2028 dates, performance clauses, or exit clauses to confirmed contract terms without a primary source.

facts.answer_zh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 4 日，他仍是 McLaren F1 车手。
facts.answer_en: As of 4 September 2026, he remains a McLaren Formula 1 driver.
facts.limitations: Recheck before answering any transfer, contract, or future-team question.

facts.value: Piastri said in August 2025 that their relationship and way of working had not changed as the title pressure increased.
facts.answer_zh: 在 2025 年 8 月的公开表态中，Piastri 说他与 Lando Norris 的关系和工作方式没有因争冠压力改变。
facts.answer_en: In a public statement in August 2025, Piastri said that his relationship and way of working with Lando Norris had not changed under title pressure.
facts.limitations: This supports a public professional relationship only. It does not prove private friendship, private conflict, or what either person feels.

facts.answer_zh: 他的职业管理团队由前 F1 车手 Mark Webber 参与领导。
facts.answer_en: Former Formula 1 driver Mark Webber is part of the leadership of his management team.
facts.limitations: Do not infer private advice or negotiations that have not been made public.
